# Reflectoring

> > Reflectoring is a software development blog focused on Spring Boot, Java, and modern software engineering practices with practical tutorials and in-depth guides.

Created by Tom Hombergs, Reflectoring provides comprehensive tutorials on Spring Boot configuration, testing patterns, Gradle build automation, Node.js development, and software craftsmanship principles. The site emphasizes hands-on learning with real-world examples for Java developers and engineers building maintainable applications.

## Key Topics

- Spring Boot
- Java
- Gradle
- Spring Framework
- @ConfigurationProperties
- Testing patterns
- Configuration management
- Node.js
- Software craftsmanship
- Clean code
- Design principles
- External configuration
- IntelliJ IDEA
- Build automation
- Beginner guides

## Spring Boot Configuration and Setup

- [Getting Started with Spring Boot](https://reflectoring.io/getting-started-with-spring-boot): Spring Boot beginner guide with Spring Initializr and IntelliJ setup
- [Configuring a Spring Boot Module with @ConfigurationProperties](https://reflectoring.io/spring-boot-configuration-properties): Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties tutorial for external configuration
- [Loading External Application Properties in the Gradle bootRun Task](https://reflectoring.io/externalizing-properties-gradle-bootrun): Spring Boot Gradle bootRun with external application properties
- [Testing with Spring Boot's @TestConfiguration Annotation](https://reflectoring.io/spring-boot-testconfiguration): Spring Boot @TestConfiguration for custom test beans and mocking

## Java Development Tutorials

- [Getting Started With Java: Build a Robot Arena](https://reflectoring.io/first-java-program-robot-arena): Java beginner tutorial building a robot arena with IntelliJ setup
- [Combining Object Mother and Fluent Builder for the Ultimate Test Data Factory](https://reflectoring.io/objectmother-fluent-builder): Java testing patterns: Object Mother + Fluent Builder for test data
- [Guide to Sorting in Kotlin](https://reflectoring.io/sorting%20in%20kotlin): Kotlin sorting guide for collections, lists, and arrays

## Software Craftsmanship and Best Practices

- [The Art of Writing Clean Code: A Key to Maintainable Software](https://reflectoring.io/clean-code): Clean code practices for maintainable software development
- [Single Responsibility Principle Unpacked](https://reflectoring.io/single-responsibility-principle): Deep dive into SRP benefits and drawbacks in software design

## Gradle and Build Automation

- [Getting the current Subversion Revision Number in Gradle](https://reflectoring.io/getting-svn-revision-in-gradle): Gradle tutorial for using Subversion revision numbers in builds

## Node.js Development

- [Publish and Receive Messages with Google Pub/Sub in Node.js](https://reflectoring.io/google-pub-sub-in-node-js): Node.js tutorial for Google Cloud Pub/Sub messaging integration
- [Scheduling Jobs with Node.js](https://reflectoring.io/schedule-cron-job-in-node): Node.js cron job scheduling guide using node-cron library

## DevOps and Operations

- [5 Good Reasons to Use a Log Server](https://reflectoring.io/log-server): Centralized logging benefits and log server analysis advantages
